courseTitle: Swin intim ek sanz kous – Nivo 1
pageTitle: Swin intim ek sanz kous – Nivo 1 · Inspired
pageDescription: Enn formasion enn-er lor bann konesans pou swin intim bann tipti zanfan, avek sis modil, bann explikasion viziel ek enn lalis verifikasion separe pou obzervasion pratik anba sipervizion lekol. Version pou revizion.
safeguarding: Tipti zanfan · Dignite dan bann swin toulezour
heroLead: Donn bann swin avek lasirans ek respe, an reflesisan lor sak letap. Pou bann profeser ek asistan profeser ki travay avek bann tipti zanfan.
pilotTitle: Version pou revizion · Bizin laprobasion lokal
pilotNotice: Formasion baze lor bann gid internasional, pou revizion. Avan personel servi li, bizin aprouv bann prosedir lekol, organizasion personel, plan swin ek tradiksion. Fin formasion an-lign montre bann konesans ek refleksion; li pa etabli konpetans pratik. Ou progre res dan sa navigater-la.
showActText: Sis refleksion lor bann sitiasion pratik, sis verifikasion rapid ek enn evaliasion 20 kestion. Ou bizin reponn korekteman tou le sink kestion esansiel lor sekirite.
completionEvidenceText: Terminn sak modil, gagn omwin 80% avek tou bann repons esansiel korek, ek rekonet ou bann responsabilite. Apre, organiz enn obzervasion pratik separe anba sipervizion dan lekol.
timing: Modil ek aktivite: 48 minit · Evaliasion: 10 minit · Konfirmasion: 2 minit. Pou verifye sa bann dire-la pandan enn test pilot avek personel.
applyUnderstanding: 2. Met seki ou finn konpran an pratik
responsePrivacy: Servi zis sitiasion imaziner-la. Pa rant okenn vre insidan konsernan proteksion zanfan ni okenn detay lor bann zanfan. Bann repons anrezistre lor sa laparey-la pou ou relir; zot pa anvwaye kot enn lekol.
response3: Explik bann letap dan lord ek bann desizion lor sekirite avek ou prop mo.
response5: Servi zis sitiasion imaziner-la pou explik seki ou pou met an ekri ek ou bann desizion pou signale.
responseOther: Reponn bann kestion lao avek ou prop mo.
saveResponse: Anrezistre repons ek get bann explikasion
moduleConfirm: Mo finn travay lor toulede parti, pran kont bann explikasion ek fer aktivite-la momem.
reflectionUngraded: Sa refleksion-la obligatwar me li pa gagn not. Konpar li avek bann explikasion avan ou kontigne.
activityDisclaimer: Sa refleksion obligatwar-la pa gagn not. Li konte pou terminn formasion an-lign, me li pa etabli konpetans pratik.

finishModules: Terminn tou le sis modil avan
finishModulesText: Fer sak verifikasion rapid ek aktivite, apre konfirme ki ou finn travay lor modil-la. Ou finn terminn {count} lor 6 modil.
judgement: Ou zizman lor bann swin intim
quizLead: Swazir enn repons pou sak kestion. Pou reisi kestioner-la, ou bizin gagn omwin 16 lor 20 ek reponn tou le sink kestion esansiel korekteman.
quizPrivacy: Enn sertifika fin formasion an-lign disponib apre ki tou bann kondisyon finn ranpli. Zame bann rezilta soumet dan enn sistem santral ouswa anvwaye otomatikman par imel.
question: Kestion {n}

quizMet: Nivo neseser pou kestioner-la finn atenn
certificateLead: Ou finn ranpli bann kondisyon pou terminn formasion an-lign. Telesarz ou sertifika ek ou bann rezilta konplet, apre organiz obzervasion pratik separe-la avek ou lekol.
checklistLead: Ranpli bann kondisyon ki reste dan lalis anba pou deblok ou sertifika.
progressLead: Travay lor tou le sis modil ek evaliasion-la pou gagn ou sertifika fin formasion an-lign. Validasion pratik res enn responsabilite separe lekol.
addParticipant: Azout ou nom, ou ladres imel travay, ou lekol ek ladres imel ou Head (responsab lekol).
criticalPositions: Ou bizin reponn kestion 3, 6, 8, 10 ek 11 korekteman.
onlineOnly: Zis konesans ek refleksion an-lign. Konpetans pratik bizin enn obzervasion ek enn validasion separe anba sipervizion lekol. Bann refleksion pa gagn not.
fullResultsHead: Bann rezilta konplet pou ou responsab lekol
addDetailsReport: Azout ou bann detay partisipan pou prepar rapor-la.
reportPrivacy: Rapor konplet-la inklir tou ou bann repons dan kestioner-la ek zot explikasion, tou ou bann refleksion ekri, ou konfirmasion, listorik ou bann tantativ ek leta ou sertifika. Lanvwa otomatik pa konekte. Telesarz imel ki finn prepare ek anvway li atraver ou aplikasion imel, ouswa atas fisie rezilta-la oumem.
reviewExplanations: Reget bann explikasion avan ou fer enn nouvo tantativ.
contactLead: Konfirm sa bann kontak ek prosedir spesifik pou ou lekol-la avan personel donn bann swin intim. Bann plas ki ankor pou ranpli pa enn regleman lokal aprouve.
noIncident: Pa servi sa formasion-la pou signale enn insidan
contactNotice: Si ou ena enn inkietid aktiel, servi prosedir proteksion zanfan ki ou lekol deza ena. Si ena enn danze imedia, swiv bann dispozision pou bann ka irzan ou lekol ek rod led irzan.

Lor enn laparey ki lezot dimounn osi servi, servi enn lafnet prive, telesarz ou bann dokiman, apre ferm lafnet-la. Pa rant nom okenn zanfan, okenn vre insidan ouswa okenn dosie lekol konfidansiel.

emailIntro: Silvouple trouv mo bann rezilta an-lign pou Swin intim ek sanz kous – Nivo 1 anba. Mo bann refleksion finn termine me pa finn gagn not. Sa pa etabli konpetans pratik; bizin enn obzervasion separe ki lekol finn aprouve.
emailReady: Imel ki finn prepare pare. Li PA finn anvwaye. Ouver li dan ou aplikasion imel, verifye destinater-la ek anvway li. Si ou aplikasion pa kapav modifie bann fisie .eml, atas bann rezilta konplet ek sertifika-la dan enn nouvo imel. Klik lor lien-la si telesarzman pa finn koumanse:
contactCards: Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL) · Responsab deziye pou proteksion zanfan
Bann inkietid lor enn zanfan, bann revelasion ek soutien pou proteksion zanfan.
Kisannla pou kontakte kan DSL pa disponib ouswa konserne par enn inkietid.
Head / prosedir pou bann inkietid lor personel
Prosedir aprouve pou bann inkietid lor konportman enn adilt. Bann inkietid ki konsern Principal: Exec Head, bann lezot responsab seksion ouswa biro santral Inspired.
Organizasion personel aprouve, plan swin, dispozision pou obzervasion ek lanrezistreman bann swin abitie.
Soutien pou lasante ek kontrol bann infeksion
Bann prodwi aprouve, netwayaz, lekipman proteksion individiel (PPE), bann problem lapo ek konsey medikal.
Bann dispozision pou bann ka irzan
Kouma gagn led imedia ek asistans medikal irzan.
translationReviewNotice: Sa tradiksion an Kreol Morisien-la ankor pe atann revizion par enn dimounn ki metrize lang-la ek ki ena lexpertiz dan bann swin intim ek proteksion zanfan. Si enn fraz pa kler, verifye li avek version angle ki fer referans ek prosedir ki ou lekol finn aprouve.
translationReviewShort: Tradiksion Kreol Morisien ankor pou revize par enn spesialis ki metrize lang-la.
localNoticeTitle: Avan ou donn bann swin dan ou lekol
localNoticeText: Konn plan swin aprouve-la, organizasion personel ek sirveyans, bann prodwi ek metod netwayaz, sistem lanrezistreman ek bann kontak pou signale pli lao. Si sa bann detay-la pa kler, demann lekol gid ou avan ou kontigne.
practicalLead: Telesarz ouswa inprim sa lalis verifikasion vid-la pou enn obzervater ki lekol finn otorize. Terminn sa formasion an-lign-la zame mark sa lalis-la kouma reisi.
practicalDownload: Telesarz lalis verifikasion pratik an PDF
practicalBlank: Formiler lekol vid · Ranpli ek gard li atraver prosedir sekirize ki lekol finn aprouve
observationContext: Konteks obzervasion (san detay ki idantifie enn zanfan)
evidenceNotes: Bann prev ek explikasion (san detay ki idantifie enn zanfan)
checklistDisclaimer: Sa se enn zouti vid pou ed obzervasion, pa enn sertifika konpetans ki finn valide. Zis lekol kapav anrezistre so desizion apre enn evaliasion apropriye anba sipervizion.
practicalCallout: Prosenn letap: montre enn pratik an sekirite
practicalCalloutText: Ou lekol swazir obzervater-la, prosedir aprouve-la, enn similasion apropriye ek okenn pratik anba sipervizion. Telesarz lalis verifikasion separe-la ek organiz ou obzervasion.
localReadyLead: Bann prinsip komin pa ranplas lalwa lokal, enn prosedir aprouve ouswa plan individiel enn zanfan. Lekol bizin reviz sa bann eleman-la avan personel servi formasion-la.
sourceLead: Baze lor bann gid internasional, pa lor enn sel standar internasional. Bann sours kapav donn bann gid diferan; ou lekol bizin aprouv prosedir ki aplik lokalman.
visualCaveat: Bann ilistrasion anime orizinal, pa bann demonstrasion filme par bann exper ni enn validasion pratik. Swiv prosedir lokal aprouve-la; pratik anba enn sipervizion apropriye.
visualComplete: Explikasion-la finn fini. Reget enn letap ouswa zwe li ankor.
reviewBanner: Bizin reviz prosedir lokal ek lang-la avan personel servi formasion-la. Fin formasion an-lign ek konpetans pratik se de zafer separe.
sourcesDate: Bann sours verifye pou sa version pou revizion-la: 3 Oktob 2026
durationNote: Obzervasion pratik azout letan anplis formasion an-lign ki dir anviron enn-er.
